title: GuildBound Idle
author: Guildbound
selftext:
Was a bit hesitant at first when and if I should share this project of mine because that’s what this is not trying to get rich or publish on Steam. But just a game mechanic I grew up with playing Ultima online, in which gear you crafted gets engraved with your name on it, and you are well known for being a grandmaster blacksmith or tailor , etc  so just wanted to share my little project runs on pc and mobile. You can leave urself idling gathering or if you have enough resources crafting.   
Things in the game   
PvP   
Leaderboards  
Crafting   
A bunch of skills including taming where u have a chance to tame a pet equip it and give you buffs  
Traveling   
Combat  
Dungeons  
Events that rotate   
World bosses  
Party up with ur friends and grind  
Duels in town  
A focus effect that rewards you for being active.  
Quests   
Gods that give you buffs in exchange for tithe

If you find any bugs please let me know I will fix asap!!  
We do have a discord if interested all are welcome   
Thank you AI Game Devs!

And if you have any games u want honest feedback and don’t mind the criticism send em my way!! I’ll DM u the results( will also use my LLm to run simulations)
